evidence.summary: POST /api/cart/items creates a CartItem from cartId, productId and String(quantity) taken straight from the request body; no validation or permission check in the handler.
POST /api/checkout creates a Stripe Checkout session (mode 'payment') with line_items taken unchanged from the request body, and returns the session.
The Stripe client is created from the environment variable STRIPE_SECRET (value not in the source).
Prisma model Cart: id String uuid default, userId String, items CartItem[].
Prisma model CartItem: id String uuid default, cartId String, productId String, quantity String (comment: stored as text).
There is no Product model: productId points at products kept somewhere else, and nothing ties checkout line items to the cart.

database: Prisma ^5.10.0 (provider not declared in the schema file)

architecture.frontend: none in the source (JSON API only)
architecture.backend: Express route module taking (app, prisma); Prisma client; Stripe SDK

features.name: Add item to cart
features.description: Add a product with a quantity to a cart through POST /api/cart/items.
features.observed_behaviour: Creates a CartItem row with the cartId, productId and quantity from the body (quantity converted to a string) and returns the row.
features.business_logic: No validation: quantity is stored as text, cartId is chosen by the client, and no check that the cart belongs to the caller is visible.

features.name: Stripe checkout
features.description: Pay through a Stripe Checkout session created by POST /api/checkout.
features.observed_behaviour: Passes the request's items to Stripe as line_items in payment mode and returns the session object.
features.business_logic: Prices and items come from the client unchecked (client can set its own price); the cart is not read and no order record is written; no webhook confirms payment.
features.integration: Stripe API with the STRIPE_SECRET key

configuration.purpose: Stripe secret API key (name only; no value in the source)

error_handling.behaviour: No try/catch in the handlers; behaviour depends on Express defaults outside this source

unknowns: No Product model: where products, names and prices come from is not in the source.
The Express app and Prisma client are created outside server.js; any auth middleware there cannot be seen.
Schema has no datasource/generator block and no @relation on CartItem.cartId, so the database provider and referential rules are unknown.
No Stripe webhook or order record: how a payment is confirmed is not in the source.
No frontend or screens exist in the source; the app is a JSON API only.
